# Yahoo Finance

> > Comprehensive financial platform providing real-time stock market data, business news, portfolio management tools, and investment research.

Yahoo Finance is one of the world's leading financial media platforms, offering live quotes, market analysis, trending stock data, and news coverage from Reuters, Motley Fool, and other sources. The platform serves investors with tools for tracking portfolios, researching securities, and monitoring global financial markets including stocks, ETFs, cryptocurrencies, futures, and currencies.

## Key Topics

- Stock market data and live quotes
- Portfolio management and tracking
- Market indexes and futures
- Cryptocurrency quotes (Bitcoin)
- Trending stocks and tickers
- Financial news and business headlines
- Symbol lookup and ticker search
- Investment analysis and research
- Global financial markets
- ETFs and mutual funds
- Currencies and bonds
- Company coverage (Adobe, Block, Ulta Beauty, Rivian, Airbnb)
- Market analysis and insights
- Brokerage integration
- Real-time market updates

## Core Platform

- [Yahoo Finance - Stock Market Live, Quotes, Business & Finance News](https://finance.yahoo.com/?fr=sycsrp_catchall): Homepage with live stock quotes, market news, and portfolio management
- [Markets: World Indexes, Futures, Bonds, Currencies, Stocks & ETFs](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/?fr=sycsrp_catchall): Market overview with real-time data on indexes, futures, bonds, currencies
- [Stock Portfolio Management & Tracker](https://finance.yahoo.com/portfolios/?fr=sycsrp_catchall): Portfolio tracking tool with brokerage integration and performance metrics
- [Symbol Lookup from Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/lookup?s=ERI): Search tool for stock, ETF, mutual fund, and futures ticker symbols

## Financial News & Analysis

- [Finance News: Wall Street, financial markets, stocks, securities and more](https://finance.yahoo.com/news?fr=sycsrp_catchall): Financial news aggregation from Reuters, Motley Fool, and other sources
- [Latest News](https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/latest-news/?fr=sycsrp_catchall): Latest financial news covering stocks, investments, and market trends

## Market Screeners & Trending Data

- [Top Trending Stocks: US stocks with the highest interest today](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/trending/?fr=sycsrp_catchall): Trending US stocks screener showing Adobe, Block, Ulta Beauty performance

## Regional Platforms

- [Yahoo! Finance Canada | Stock Market Live, Quotes, Business & Finance News](https://ca.finance.yahoo.com/): Canadian homepage with BMO, Canadian Press coverage of local markets
